findings.claim: The spec makes dash-leading tags valid (a lone '-') but no criterion or test says how the CLI receives them, and argparse treats '-x' after --tag as an option, so the 'one stderr line, exit 2' contract is not what the user sees.
findings.failure_scenario: `tasklist add X --tag -x` or `tasklist tag 1 -x`: argparse rejects it with a multi-line usage message instead of storing the tag (valid per AC-1) or printing `error: invalid tag: -x`; a build that does this passes every listed test.
findings.rule: AC-1, AC-2 (request item 1: dashes are valid; invalid values give one stderr line)
findings.evidence: a lone '-' is a valid tag
